issues.label: Merger of credit card counts into robbery
issues.why: Court must determine whether unlawful acquisition of credit cards merges into aggravated robbery under statutory and lesser-included-offense merger principles.

issues.label: Multiplicity of three credit card counts
issues.why: Whether taking three cards in one transaction supports three separate convictions or a single offense affects double jeopardy analysis.

issues.label: Robbery vs. theft for car keys
issues.why: Whether force or fear was used to take the keys distinguishes aggravated robbery from mere theft.

issues.label: Sufficiency of evidence on each count
issues.why: Court must ensure the jury's verdicts on all counts are supported by legally sufficient evidence.

issues.label: Consent defense to sexual assault
issues.why: The defense account raised consent, requiring proper jury resolution and instruction on the element of non-consent.

issues.label: PSI inaccuracy resolution requirement
issues.why: Statute requires the court to make findings or resolve alleged PSI inaccuracies identified by defense counsel.

issues.label: Waiver of PSI objections
issues.why: Whether counsel's 'that's it' response waived or preserved the PSI correction issue for appeal.

issues.label: Consecutive vs. concurrent sentencing factors
issues.why: Court must properly weigh statutory factors (gravity, number of victims, history, rehabilitative needs) before imposing consecutive sentences.

issues.label: Consideration of defendant's age
issues.why: Whether court adequately considered that consecutive sentences amount to effective life without parole given age fifty-two.

issues.label: Reliance on inaccurate PSI at sentencing
issues.why: Sentencing based on unresolved allegedly false PSI statements could render the sentence improper.

issues.label: Penalizing defendant for maintaining innocence
issues.why: Court's reliance on defendant's 'not credible' testimony and lack of accountability may improperly punish exercise of trial rights.

issues.label: Aggravated sexual assault sentence enhancement
issues.why: Fifteen-to-life sentence requires the court to find lesser sentence not in interests of justice under the applicable statute.

issues.label: Double jeopardy for assault and sexual assault
issues.why: Whether aggravated assault and aggravated sexual assault arising from same conduct constitute impermissible multiple punishments.

issues.label: Elements of aggravated sexual assault
issues.why: Court must confirm aggravating factors (strangulation, weapon) were properly charged and found for each count.

issues.label: Consideration of rehabilitative needs
issues.why: Court must genuinely weigh rehabilitative potential, not merely public safety and criminal history.

issues.label: Prosecutorial characterizations at sentencing
issues.why: Whether the State's inflammatory statements improperly influenced the sentence.
